season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep; web search (Mountain Project, SummitPost, Mountaineers) shows Dorado routes climbed July-August; 137 of 192 ascents here are July-August.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged as plain Southwest Buttress; one team took a harder variation but the report calls the line standard, so it is assigned to the Southwest Buttress

season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep; East Ridge logged July-September.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged East Ridge, 2023-07-09, summited, but the track starts at the glacier camp and ends at the trailhead, so it is not a complete round trip

season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep; web search (Mountaineers, Mountain Project) puts the standard line in July-August; logged "NW ridge" ascents are Jun-Sep, mostly July.

track.why: Logged "NW ridge with wrap around SW face variation" on 2023-07-30, summited, round trip from the trailhead pin; the line climbs the northwest ridge after a lower start on the southwest face, per the report

otherTracksConsidered.why: Blank logged route; report mentions 5.4 pitch, a crack crux and a ridge that lost a block around 2019, which fits the northwest ridge but is never named
Logged northwest ridge, but the track continues onto other peaks of the traverse (link-up)

facts.text: Early July: the step from the snow finger onto the rock across the moat is committing and worsens as it melts.
Mid-August: the glacier below the ridge is badly broken; finding the crossing to the upper glacier takes careful routefinding.
The hand-crack block near the summit can be sidestepped by placing a large cam and belaying a short traverse to the right (mid-August).
Pickets for the steep snow below the rock (early July)

season.evidence: Stored late July-August; web search (Mountain Project, SummitPost, trip reports) shows the approach gully can be hard to identify in early July; ascents here are July-August.

track.why: Logged Southwest Buttress on 2015-07-18; report describes the notch above the McAllister Glacier, the base of the southwest ridge, a left-leaning corner start and nine pitches; the track runs trailhead to summit (one-way, ends at our summit pin within 23 m). One team took a harder variation but the line is the standard buttress.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged SW Butt but track continues as a multi-day link-up to Klawatti and the moraine lake

facts.text: In mid-July the notch above the McAllister Glacier is bare and loose; descend to snow and walk around the first rib rather than crossing it on rock.
The route starts at a left-leaning corner at the far end of a rock plateau, reached from the right.

notes: The Direct Southwest Buttress and Southwest Buttress share approach and summit, so only logged route names separate them. Most recordings are link-ups with Eldorado, Klawatti or the Inspiration traverse.
